name: ArtificialIntelligence
summary: This EA uses a linear perceptron model with four weights applied to Accelerator Oscillator (AC) indicator values at shifts 0, 7, 14, and 21 bars to generate buy/sell signals. When a signal opposes an existing profitable position, it performs a position reversal with increased volume; otherwise it trails the stop loss to breakeven plus spread. All positions require a stop loss and there is no take profit.
summary_zh: 该EA使用线性感知器模型，将四个权重分别应用于加速振荡器(AC)指标在偏移0、7、14和21根K线的值来生成买卖信号。当信号与现有盈利仓位方向相反时，以加量反转仓位；否则将止损移至保本加点差水平。所有仓位必须设止损，不设止盈。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于线性感知器，将AC指标的四个不同偏移值乘以可优化权重后求和，输出值大于0时做多，小于0时做空。入场条件为感知器输出信号触发，且满足止损距离要求。出场条件主要依赖止损，但在持仓盈利超过止损加2倍止损加点的距离时，若出现反向信号则反转仓位（加大手数），若无反向信号则将止损移至开仓价水平实现保本。仓位管理方面，反转时手数为原仓位手数加新开仓手数，存在加仓行为。资金管理方面仅使用固定手数，无动态仓位调整机制。整体策略缺乏止盈逻辑，完全依赖止损和保本移动来控制风险收益比。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy is based on a linear perceptron that multiplies four AC indicator values at different bar shifts by optimizable weights and sums them; a positive output signals a buy and a negative output signals a sell. Entry conditions require the perceptron signal to trigger and the calculated stop loss to meet the broker's minimum stop level distance. Exit conditions rely primarily on stop loss, but when a position is profitable by more than twice the stop loss distance plus spread, the EA either reverses the position with increased volume on an opposing signal or trails the stop to breakeven if no opposing signal exists. Position sizing adds the new lot size to the existing position volume during reversals, which effectively increases exposure. Money management uses only fixed lot sizing with no dynamic adjustment based on equity or risk percentage. The strategy entirely lacks a take profit mechanism, depending solely on stop loss and breakeen trailing to manage the risk-reward ratio.

parameters.name: Shift
parameters.description: 指标检查的K线偏移：0为当前成形K线，1为第一根已成形K线
parameters.description_en: Bar shift for indicator check: 0=current forming bar, 1=last formed bar

pros: 使用感知器模型对AC指标进行加权组合，相比单一指标信号更有灵活性
具有保本移动止损机制，在盈利达到一定幅度后将止损移至开仓价水平锁定利润
止损为必选参数，确保每笔交易都有风险退出机制
反转仓位时增加了成交量，可以在趋势反转时放大收益
pros_en: The perceptron model applies weighted combinations to AC indicator values, offering more flexibility than single-indicator signals
Includes a breakeven stop loss trailing mechanism that locks in profit once the position moves sufficiently in favor
Stop loss is mandatory, ensuring every trade has a risk exit in place
Position reversal with increased volume can amplify gains when the market genuinely reverses direction
cons: 反转时加仓导致风险敞口增大，在连续错误信号时可能快速亏损
完全缺乏止盈机制，盈利仓位只能通过保本止损或反向信号反转来退出，可能回吐大量利润
感知器权重需要优化但缺乏自适应机制，在市场状态变化后权重可能失效
固定手数不做资金管理，无法根据账户规模动态调整风险
cons_en: Position reversal increases exposure by adding volume, which can lead to rapid losses on consecutive false signals
Completely lacks a take profit mechanism, meaning profitable positions can only exit via breakeen trailing or reversal, potentially giving back significant gains
Perceptron weights require optimization but have no adaptive mechanism, so they may become ineffective after market regime changes
Fixed lot sizing with no money management means risk cannot be dynamically adjusted based on account size
improvements: 增加动态仓位管理，根据账户权益和风险比例自动调整手数
添加止盈机制或移动止盈，避免盈利仓位大幅回撤
引入感知器权重的自适应优化机制，使权重能随市场状态变化自动调整
improvements_en: Add dynamic position sizing that adjusts lot size based on account equity and a risk percentage parameter
Implement a take profit or trailing take profit mechanism to prevent significant drawdowns on winning positions
Introduce an adaptive optimization mechanism for perceptron weights so they can adjust to changing market conditions

risk_points: 反转加仓机制使单次交易风险翻倍，连续反转可导致累积亏损快速扩大
无止盈机制依赖保本止损移动，但若价格快速反转可能来不及移动止损就已回吐利润
感知器权重过拟合风险高，历史优化参数在未来可能失效
risk_points_en: The reversal with added volume doubles risk per trade, and consecutive reversals can compound losses rapidly
No take profit means relying on breakeen trailing, but sharp price reversals may give back profits before the stop can be moved
High risk of perceptron weight overfitting, as historically optimized parameters may fail in live markets
